correctness.rationale: The two quantified confluences are exactly inclusion of consecutive coordinatewise row downsets and upward closure of suffix unions. Probes of p circle q recover each downset bit; negated truth of p bullet q recovers each suffix union bit. Induction on formula complexity using hereditary truth sets proves all-depth equivalence. Maximal downset elements and newly appearing suffix elements are independently mandatory in each row; optional elements form the exact Boolean intervals, giving 2^sum_i |(D_i cap S_{i+1}) minus Max(D_i)| presentations, and at most n^2-1 free pairs for each of n-1 rows. Full rows attain the sharp maximum 2^((n-1)(n^2-1)), including n=1. checker.py exhausts n=1 and n=2 original quantified semantics against direct modal operations, samples n=3, and evaluates random nested formulas; finite checks are diagnostics, not substitutes for the complete proof.

value.rationale: Explicit representation of the indistinguishability quotient for a recently introduced paired binary intuitionistic modality, not a routine rephrasing of a modal axiom. It proves sharp exponential redundancy in admissible relation presentations, with computable least/greatest representatives and an exact Boolean fiber parameterization. The precise invariant is motivated intrinsically by the question of whether distinct ternary frames can be distinguished by any valuation and any formula; its all-n solution can remove representational duplication from finite-frame studies.
